newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern files $1.25 bln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern files $1.25 bln shelf.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $1.25 billion in debt securities and preferred and common stock.
When combined with a previous registration, Norfolk will have a total $1.3 billion in equities available for sale, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be used retire all or a portion of the corporation short-term indebtedness, to acquire new or used property, including without limitation locomotives and rolling stock, Norfolk said in the filing.
Proceeds will also be used to meet general corporate purposes and to accomplish any other purpose approved by a duly authorized officer of the corporation.
Norfolk said proceeds will use to purchase common shares from time to time on the open market as part of an ongoing share purchase program commenced by the corporation in 1987.
